description:
Specialized 3D scanning and post-processing software for Trackit 3D scanners.

Revo Track enables point cloud capture, post-processing, and multi-model alignment, empowering you to scan and process quickly.
1. Adapts the Mac version to support Trackit SR.
2. Optimizes the calibration process, supporting calibration resumption after an unexpected exit.
3. Adds an optimization level for Fast Mesh, improving processing speed.
4. For Trackit SR, optimizes the user experience of using a mixed wired and wireless connection, improving frame rate and connection stability.
5. Improves the stability of Trackit SR wireless scanning.
6. Optimizes the display effect during laser scanning.
7. Improves marker fusion quality during multi-position scans and marker scans.
8. Adds a toggle to remove isolated points under point cloud fusion.
9. Adds ply point cloud format support for Global Marker export.
10. Fixes some bugs.
